posts.title: 24/11/26 - Down intoto Dawlish
posts.description: Not a Pub Town Wishing to avoid the potholes and the death road that is Breakneck Hill, we leave the motor at home and like last week's walk into Teignmouth, head downhill. picking up the coast path into Dawlish. It's a decent enough walk - with good views over the railway line to the sea. Hitting the coast path Looking over the railway line An hurrah on the beach Into Dawlish for the second time

posts.title: 23/11/26 - Stover Country Park
posts.description: Escape the Rain Our gaff for the week is on the high ground outside of Teignmouth. From one decking, we can see Dawlish and if there is a blinking light at night, it is the lighthouse at Portland Bill. Except not today, we are in the clouds and mizzle.
